# Regression/exercise test for the automap tile-reveal + fill renderer.
#
# TELEPORTs to every walkable tile (tile-type nibble != 0) in the
# upper-left quadrant of level 1 -- coordinates generated by directly
# reading DAT_002029cc's tile-type data, not guessed -- calling REVEAL
# after each so the ring-walk marks that tile revealed (TELEPORT and
# ordinary movement don't trigger the reveal ring-walk on their own;
# see memory.md's automap-reveal section). Ends by opening the map and
# saving a screenshot.
#
# With DAT_00086bf0 and DAT_000842c0 both recovered/reconstructed, the
# automap now draws blue-filled rooms and corridors with dark wall
# edges -- matching the reference layout. The content still doesn't
# reach the visible on-screen flush, so run with UW_DEBUG_DRAW=1 and
# look at the LAST draw dump under debug/drawdumps/<timestamp>/ :
#   UW_DEBUG_DRAW=1 UW_DATA_DIR="$(pwd)/data" UW_FAST_SLEEP=1 \
#     UW_DEMO_FILE=demo_automap.txt UW_DEMO_DELAY_MS=5 ./build/uw_dbg
#
# Big on purpose (~700 tiles) so the filled region is substantial
# enough to eyeball against the real level layout. Uses the real
# chargen navigation scheme (D-pad Up = confirm/advance).
